Great Dog Rescue New England, a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, would like you to meet Pukita, a little 15-pound girl who has been through quite a journey. The specific details of Pukita’s early life are shrouded in mystery, but she somehow found herself living as a stray at a landfill in Mexico. When she was discovered, workers called a local rescue, who in turn brought Pukita, as well as over 30 other cats and dogs, to a local park to hopefully find potential homes. It was there that the Great Dog Rescue New England team came upon Pukita while they were visiting Mexico. According to them, “It's been a long journey to get this girl medical records and a passport, but we're happy to say that she is coming to New England at the end of June, and now she is looking for a family to love and call her own.”
